# Paaru Studio-Media

> Paaru Studio-Media is a full-service video production and creative advertising agency based in Bangalore, India. The agency specializes in corporate films, ad films (TVCs and digital), brand videos, performance marketing, influencer marketing, outdoor/OOH advertising, and AI-assisted video content generation.

## Overview & Core Capabilities

Paaru Studio-Media delivers end-to-end creative and media solutions for growing startups and established enterprise brands across India:

- **Video Production**: Commercials, brand films, corporate videos, explainer videos, 2D/3D animations, product showcases, and viral social video campaigns.
- **AI Video & Content Generation**: Fast-turnaround generative AI video, AI reels, virtual production, and automated video workflows for digital-first brands.
- **Media Offerings & OOH**: Billboard advertising, metro ads, digital out-of-home (DOOH), transit media, and broadcast media planning.
- **Performance & Digital Marketing**: ROI-focused digital campaigns, paid social, Google performance marketing, and creative asset scaling.
- **Influencer & Social Media**: Creator partnerships, campaign management, and content strategy across platforms.

- [Case Studies](https://paarustudio.com/case-studies): Real campaign breakdowns and production portfolios for clients including Calvin Klein, GIVA, Herbalife, Japfa, and Onsurity.
